instruction.thesis: GOLD short (FUNDING_EXTREME_LONG) has achieved +2.16% gain. Gold spot has fallen from 4,661 to 4,561 (-2.15%), and the primary signal — extreme funding at 67.52% annualized — has normalized dramatically to 19.97% (a -70% decline). The funding normalization is the core thesis completion signal: crowded longs have been flushed, funding is no longer extreme, and the easy carry + mean reversion trade is largely done. The 5% target has not been hit but the signal family evidence shows thesis completion. With gold PM IV now elevated at 26.3% (vs 22.5% at entry) and gold_pm_settle_ev rising to 5,097 (vs 5,040 at entry), there is some upside risk if gold rebounds. Taking profit near the 2% gain level while the thesis evidence is clear.
